newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says savings must exceed target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says savings must exceed target.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd's steel business needs to exceed the original target of savings of A$500 million, division head Ron McNeilly said on Tuesday.
"It's got to be a lot more than A$500 million," McNeilly said at a news conference when asked a question about the overall effect on costs from measures announced on Tuesday.
"We have talked about A$500 million needing to come out of the cost base ... we would expect to see organisational arrangements announced today ... will also deliver further cost savings," he said.
BHP called the news conference to discuss its announcement earlier on Tuesday that it would phase out steelmaking at its Newcastle plant by the end of 1999.
The company also said it planned to close its Geelong rod mill and Sydney wire mill in 1999.
Based on a review of domestic and international steel operations, BHP said it would disband its international steel division and restructure BHP Steel around four divisions.
